device.description: 10-bit serial-control ADC with 11 analog inputs, 3 self-test modes and EOC output
device.note: tlc1543.pdf (SLAS052G) p.1 pinout (DB/DW/J/N), p.3 terminal functions, p.3-5 serial interface modes (Table 1), p.5-6 address bits (Tables 2-3), p.8 recommended operating conditions, p.10 operating characteristics (tconv, timing)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the 4-bit input address register (p.5 Table 2/3: 0-10 = A0-A10, 11-13 = self-test); reset not given (0 here)

commands.name: Address + sample clocks
commands.note: p.3/p.5: 4 address bits MSB first on the first four I/O CLOCK rising edges; sampling until the 10th falling edge, which starts the conversion (here: at the 10th clock). DATA OUT: previous result MSB at CS fall, next bits on falling edges, low from the 10th falling edge (transfers up to 16 clocks)

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.2 (options, block diagram), p.3 (terminal functions), p.3-5 (modes, Table 1), p.5-6 (address, Tables 2-3), p.8-9 (ROC), p.10 (tconv 21 us, td(I/O-DATA) 240 ns, tPZH 1.3 us, tPHZ 150 ns), p.11-12 (timing figures)
notModeled: analog inputs, references and the 14-channel multiplexer: every conversion returns the 0 V code
self-test addresses 1011/1100/1101 output 200h/000h/3FFh (Table 3); modeled as ordinary conversions returning the 0 V code; addresses 1110/1111 (undocumented) are treated the same
result pipelining: DATA OUT carries the previous conversion; the result is constant so this is not visible
modes 2, 4 and 6 (CS held low continuously, the next I/O cycle begins at EOC rising or the 16th clock): only CS-framed transfers (modes 1, 3, 5) are modeled
conversion start: the datasheet starts it on the 10th I/O CLOCK falling edge; modeled at the 10th rising edge (command completion); td(I/O-EOC) 240 ns EOC fall delay not modeled
CS abort of a conversion (td(I/O-CS) 9 us), CS setup/debounce (two internal clock edges), slow-mode synchronization loss
tValid = tPZH 1.3 us (CS fall to MSB driven); tOut = td(I/O-DATA) 240 ns; tFloat = tPHZ 150 ns
variants: TLC1542 and TLC1543 share this datasheet and are functionally identical (TLC1542: +/-0.5 LSB linearity, also M grade). FK/FN (PLCC-20) packages have a different numbering but are not in the parts list.
